sentences.text: A man was sick for 38 years.
There was a pool called Bethesda.

sentences.ko: 많은 장애가 있는 사람들이 거기 누워 있었어요.

sentences.text: Jesus asked him gently, "Do you really want to get better?"
sentences.ko: 예수님은 그에게 부드럽게 "정말 낫고 싶으냐?"고 물으셨어요.

orderQuiz: There was a pool called Bethesda.
Jesus asked him gently, "Do you really want to get better?"

mixQuiz.q: "The man had been sick for 8 years."
"Jesus healed the man on the Sabbath."

paragraphs.text: Jesus explained that his Father never stops working, not even on the Sabbath — and since he and the Father worked together, he didn't stop either. That answer only made the religious leaders angrier, because now Jesus wasn't just breaking a Sabbath rule; he was claiming God as his own Father, which put him on equal footing with God.
paragraphs.ko: 예수님은 자신의 아버지께서 안식일에도 결코 일을 멈추지 않으시며, 자신도 아버지와 함께 일한다고 설명하셨습니다. 이 대답은 종교 지도자들을 더 화나게 만들었는데, 이제 예수님이 단순히 안식일 규정을 어긴 것이 아니라 하나님을 자기 아버지라 주장함으로써 자신을 하나님과 동등하게 여기신다고 보였기 때문입니다.

paragraphs.text: Jesus made a bold promise: anyone who listens to what he says and puts their trust in the one who sent him already has life that lasts forever — they don't have to wait to be judged, because they've already crossed over from death into life.
paragraphs.ko: 예수님은 담대한 약속을 하셨습니다. 그분의 말씀을 듣고 그분을 보내신 분을 신뢰하는 사람은 이미 영원히 이어지는 생명을 가지고 있으며, 심판을 기다릴 필요 없이 이미 죽음에서 생명으로 건너갔다는 것이었습니다.

paragraphs.text: He went further, saying that someday even people who had already died would hear his voice calling them and would come back to life.
paragraphs.ko: 그분은 더 나아가, 언젠가는 이미 죽은 사람들조차도 자신의 음성을 듣고 다시 살아날 날이 올 것이라고 말씀하셨습니다.

multiSelect.text: Jesus said his Father is always at work.
The Jews were happy about Jesus's words.
Jesus said no one would hear his voice.

summaryQuiz.q: 이 문단 전체를 가장 잘 요약한 것은?

opts.text: 예수님이 아버지와 함께 일하신다고 말씀하시며, 자신을 믿는 자마다 영생을 얻는다고 하셨다
